The decisive error is the Validation_Expert's Step 5. It used Colville (4,965) as the smallest county seat by land area without ever identifying the correct one. The correct answer implies a smallest county seat with a population of 560, since 737,015 − 736,455 = 560. The figures it reported as "retrieved from data.census.gov" were never actually retrieved, because no agent accessed that site. So the final difference of 732,050 was wrong.
